features.name: Oath Spells & Tenets
features.description:
**Oath of the Guardian Spells**

| Paladin Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 3rd | litany of sure hands, shield of faith |
| 5th | mantle of the brave, spiritual weapon |
| 9th | beacon of hope, invested champion |
| 13th | banishment, inspiring speech |
| 17th | creation, hallow |

**Tenets:** Encourage Prosperity. Preserve Order. Decisive Action.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description:
At 3rd level, you gain two Channel Divinity options:

**Inspired Leadership.** As an action, choose up to CHA modifier (min 1) creatures within 30 ft you can see. For 1 minute, each has advantage on STR, CON, and CHA saving throws.

**Turn the Wild.** As an action, each creature within 30 ft with INT 4 or less that can see or hear you must make a WIS save or be turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

features.name: Aura of Awareness
features.description: Starting at 7th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 ft have advantage on initiative rolls and can't be surprised (unless incapacitated). At 18th level, range increases to 30 ft.

features.name: Hold the Line
features.description:
At 15th level, when a friendly creature within 20 ft is forced to make a saving throw, use your reaction to grant a bonus equal to your CHA modifier (min +1). If the save succeeds, the target can make one weapon attack against the attacker as a reaction (if in range).

Uses equal to CHA modifier (min 1); regain all on long rest.

payload.name: Hold the Line
payload.description: Ally within 20 ft making a save: add CHA mod to save. On success, they can make a weapon attack vs the attacker as a reaction.

features.name: Band of Heroes
features.description:
At 20th level, as an action, choose up to proficiency bonus creatures you can see (including yourself). For 1 minute each:

* Cured of disease and poison; immune to frightened and poisoned.
* Advantage on WIS and CON saving throws.
* Gain temporary HP equal to your level.

1/long rest.

payload.name: Band of Heroes
payload.description: Grant up to prof bonus creatures: cured of disease/poison, immune to frightened/poisoned, advantage on WIS/CON saves, temp HP = your level. Lasts 1 min.
